assets.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. NO architecture, NO grass, NO stadium, NO text, NO backdrop. Six LARGE dense crowd section paintings laid out in an exact TWO COLUMN by THREE ROW atlas with broad transparent gutters. Top left: dense standing Human crowd bank seen from LEFT PROFILE, all looking right into the pitch. Top right: different dense bank seen from RIGHT PROFILE looking left. Middle left: dense FRONT FACING crowd bank looking toward viewer, four densely packed tiers. Middle right: dense BACK FACING crowd bank, backs of heads and blue shoulders looking away, four packed tiers. Bottom left: genuine TOP DOWN overhead densely packed crowd looking right. assets.decision: Rejected for horizontal layout unsuitable for long side banks

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite atlas for the Old World Classic fantasy football stadium. The reference image is the visual authority for richly detailed SNES-style pixel clusters, dark outlines, weathered grey stone, heavy dark timber, brass fittings and warm torch light. Transparent background. NO crowds, NO pitch, NO text, NO banners or colored cloth in this architecture atlas. Four clearly separated horizontal rows with broad transparent gutters: top row a long straight FRONT stone retaining wall, visually thick, about 900 pixels wide and 180 tall, timber reinforcement at ends, torches on two substantial columns; second row the same wall's TOP DOWN overhead coping and timber tops, 900 wide 80 tall; third row four individual large sprites spaced apart: stone column with burning brazier front, overhead counterpart of same column, wooden bench with awning frame WITHOUT cloth front, overhead wooden bench; bottom row four spaced objects: barrel and mugs, barrel overhead, inward curved stone corner front, curved stone corner overhead. Crisp clustered pixel art matching the concept. Architecture must have strong wall thickness and stone depth, rich warm highlights and cool shadows. Orthographic front surfaces for registration to actual raised 3D planes; no overall isometric scene. All individual objects isolated with actual transparent alpha gutters. Preserve authored original pixel density, no blur. These assets will be projected by a game engine; do not draw an entire stadium.
assets.decision: Superseded by cleaner alpha/gutters in v2

assets.prompt: Precise background extraction edit. Keep every sprite, position, size, stone texture, wood texture and hard outline exactly unchanged. Remove ALL the brown/grey atmospheric backdrop and all soft glow outside solid sprite silhouettes. Export actual transparent alpha, including between rows and inside the empty bench awning frame. The entire background must be zero alpha, NOT checkerboard pixels, NOT brown, NOT a painted backdrop. Only solid architecture, fire, barrels and benches remain. No added shadows, no new objects, no text. This is a game sprite atlas needing clean transparent gutters.
assets.decision: Selected for gallery only, original alpha preserved

assets.prompt: Generate a transparent pixel-art game sprite atlas for the TWO LONG SIDELINE CROWD BANKS of the supplied stadium. Layout is FOUR TALL NARROW vertical rectangular strips side by side, each roughly 250 wide and 950 tall, with generous transparent gutters. ALL strips completely isolated, no walls, no turf, no props, no background, no text. Strip 1: dense blue/gold chibi Human home supporters seen in left side profile looking RIGHT, about 4 heads across and 18 ranks running vertically down the strip. Strip 2: different dense blue/gold Human crowd in right side profile looking LEFT, 4 heads across and 18 ranks down. Strip 3: same packed crowd looking RIGHT viewed from EXACTLY 90 degrees overhead, only tops of hair, hats, shoulders, no faces visible. Strip 4: same looking LEFT from EXACTLY 90 degrees overhead. Human crowd with some dwarfs and halflings, diverse skin and faces, medieval caps, mugs. Each head consistent 35-45 pixels wide, crisp dark outlines, rich clustered SNES-style pixel shading matching supplied concept. The long axis of each crowd bank MUST run VERTICALLY, not horizontal panels. No perspective size taper within each strip. The engine will apply world perspective. Dense tightly packed visible upper bodies, no empty ranks, no large gaps, no background.
assets.decision: Rejected for oversized heads and insufficient density
